name: io.github.dongdongbh/mindwtr
title: Mindwtr
description: Task automation via SQLite, desktop Local API, or Mindwtr Cloud; read-only by default.

environmentVariables.name: MINDWTR_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to the local Mindwtr SQLite database.

environmentVariables.name: MINDWTR_MCP_CLOUD_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional self-hosted Mindwtr Cloud base URL for Cloud mode.

environmentVariables.name: MINDWTR_MCP_CLOUD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for self-hosted Mindwtr Cloud mode.

environmentVariables.name: MINDWTR_MCP_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Desktop Local API origin, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:3456. Selects API mode.

environmentVariables.name: MINDWTR_MCP_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token from the desktop Local API settings; required in API mode.
